top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.
Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.
